verdict.rationale: Mistral documents hosted Agents that autonomously execute tasks, with built-in tools (web search, code interpreter, document library) and handoffs between agents for task delegation. Community reports also confirm a Le Chat assistant surface, but the docs present agents mainly as an API capability developers configure, not a turnkey in-product assistant. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an end-user built-in assistant (Le Chat) that accepts delegated tasks, and hands-on evidence of task delegation working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
Agents Handoffs enable seamless task delegation and workflow automation between multiple agents with diverse tools and capabilities
Code Interpreter enables safe, on-demand code execution for data analysis, graphing, and more in isolated containers
Tried Mistral OCR with both PDFs and PNGs in Le Chat
